newsitem.title: USA: Closing arguments begin in Conrail dispute.
newsitem.headline: Closing arguments begin in Conrail dispute.

text.p: Closing arguments began after two days of hearings into a suit by Norfolk Southern Corp seeking to block the first step in a planned merger between CSX Corp and Conrail Inc.
Each side in the case in U.S. District Court was given half an hour to present its arguments.

A Norfolk Southern attorney urged U.S. District Judge Donald Van Artsdalen to block CSX from closing on a tender offer for 19.9 percent of Conrail's shares Wednesday, or to block CSX from voting shares acquired in the tender until after Conrail shareholders have had a chance to vote on the merger process next month.
